expected.utterance: How many earned leaves do I get and can I carry them forward, and also what is the work from home rule?

record.utterance: How many earned leaves do I get and can I carry them forward, and also what is the work from home rule?
record.answer: Each employee receives 18 days of earned leave, 12 days of casual leave and 10 days of sick leave per calendar year [Doc_15 §1]. Unused earned leave can be carried forward to the next year up to a maximum balance of 30 days [Doc_15 §2]. Casual leave and sick leave cannot be carried forward [Doc_15 §2]. Employees may work from home up to 2 days per week with their reporting manager's approval [Doc_16 §1]. Work from home is not available during the first 3 months of probation [Doc_16 §1]. Employees on a hybrid work from home arrangement receive an internet allowance of ₹1,000 per month [Doc_16 §3].
